open_points.subject: list_customers
open_points.text: list_customers: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] MUST answer one item for each Customer list_customer_rows answers, in exactly the order it answers them and never sorted again: an erased Customer as ErasedCustomer, any other as ListedCustomer carrying its customer_ref, its name, its restricted instant and its ended date and no contact or fiscal value; it writes nothing.
open_points.other_text: list_customers: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show that Customers that are not erased are listed by name and two of one name by customer_ref, and erased ones after every Customer that is not erased, by customer_ref, names and references compared by Unicode code point, so that every list answers each Customer once in one total order.
open_points.question: Must list_customers preserve the order returned by list_customer_rows without sorting, or must it impose the stated total order?

open_points.subject: mark_customer
open_points.text: mark_customer: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST check in stage order and answer a Refusal at the first failing stage with every failure of that stage, writing nothing: a Customer that load_customer does not find answers the NOT_FOUND member of = models.RefusalCode at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_EXISTENCE constant names with the UNKNOWN_CUSTOMER member of = models.RefusalKind on the path naming customer_ref; for the END member of = models.CustomerTransition an end_date later than today answers the INVALID_REQUEST member at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_VALUES constant names with the DATE_AFTER_TODAY member on the path naming end_date; then a stated_revision other than the Customer's current revision, a stated_revision given for an erased Customer, or none given for a Customer that has a revision, answers the STALE member at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_VERSION constant names with the STALE_REVISION member on the path naming stated_revision; then an erased Customer answers the REFUSED member at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_LIFECYCLE constant names with the CUSTOMER_ERASED member on the path naming customer_ref.
open_points.other_text: mark_customer: [BEHAVIOR] MUST answer the Customer as it stands with changed false and write nothing when the transition asks for the state the mark is already in: restricting a restricted Customer, lifting an unrestricted one, resuming one whose relationship is not ended, and ending an ended relationship whatever end_date is given, the recorded date staying; an accepted change MUST move the revision by one and set last_changed_at to the given instant together, be written with replace_customer and answer CustomerChanged with its view and changed true.
open_points.question: When an already-ended Customer receives END with an end_date later than today, must the operation refuse DATE_AFTER_TODAY or answer unchanged with changed false regardless of the date?
